Definition: properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition)
BiblicalUsage: 1) midst, among, inner part, middle; 1a) inward part; 1a1) physical sense; 1a2) as seat of thought and emotion; 1a3) as faculty of thought and emotion; 1b) in the midst, among, from among (of a number of persons); 1c) entrails (of sacrificial animals)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
